title: Space Coloring Book for Kids, 24 Astronaut Rocket Planet Pages, Outer Space Alien Moon, Birthday Gift for Ages 4-8
description:
Blast off! A space coloring book with 24 big, simple pages: a child astronaut floating among the stars, a rocket launch, Saturn and its rings, a friendly alien and its flying saucer, a moon rover, an astronaut cat, a space dog, a robot friend, a UFO beaming up a cow and a capsule splashing down at home.

A fun birthday, party or travel gift for kids aged about 4 to 8 who love rockets, planets and astronauts, perfect for quiet time, car trips and rainy days.

DETAILS
- 24 coloring pages, one illustration per page
- Size: 8.5 x 11 in (21.6 x 27.9 cm)
- Flexible soft cover with a glossy full-colour outer space illustration
- Smooth, bright white 60 lb uncoated paper, great with crayons and colored pencils
- First page: THIS BOOK BELONGS TO, to write the child's name
- Recommended for ages 4 to 8

PRODUCTION AND SHIPPING
Printed on demand by our production partner in the USA and shipped with tracking. Production takes up to about 10 business days, so please order early for gifts. This item ships to the USA and Canada.

Design created by MurettoStudio with the help of AI image tools, then checked and prepared for print by me.

Photos: the first photo is the product mockup from our print partner; the lifestyle photos are digital mockups created for illustration.
